examples.en: A man was peddling umbrellas outside the station.
examples.zh: 有個男人在車站外兜售雨傘。

examples.en: They peddle handmade jewelry at the weekend market.
examples.zh: 他們在週末市集販賣手工飾品。

examples.en: Street vendors peddle snacks to tourists every evening.
examples.zh: 路邊攤販每到傍晚就向遊客叫賣小吃。

examples.en: The peddler pushed his cart down the quiet street.
examples.zh: 小販推著他的推車走過安靜的街道。

examples.en: An old peddler sold fresh fruit near the school gate.
examples.zh: 一位老小販在校門口附近賣新鮮水果。

examples.en: My grandfather worked as a peddler when he was young.
examples.zh: 我爺爺年輕時是個行商。

examples.en: Hang your coat on the peg by the door.
examples.zh: 把你的外套掛在門邊的掛鉤上。

examples.en: We tied the tent rope to a wooden peg.
examples.zh: 我們把帳篷的繩子綁在一根木樁上。

examples.en: She used a peg to keep the towel on the line.
examples.zh: 她用一個曬衣夾把毛巾固定在曬衣繩上。

senses.zh: 固定（用釘或夾子）；把…維持在某水準；使…連動

examples.en: The government pegged the price of rice at a low level.
examples.zh: 政府把米價固定在低檔。

examples.en: She pegged the wet towels to the line.
examples.zh: 她用夾子把濕毛巾固定在曬衣繩上。

examples.en: The company pegged salaries to the cost of living.
examples.zh: 公司把薪資與生活費水準連動。

examples.en: The pendulum of the old clock swung slowly back and forth.
examples.zh: 老時鐘的鐘擺緩緩地來回擺動。

examples.en: In science class, we measured how fast a pendulum swings.
examples.zh: 在自然課上，我們測量了擺錘擺動的速度。

examples.en: The pendulum stopped moving when the clock ran down.
examples.zh: 時鐘的動力耗盡後，擺錘就停止擺動了。

examples.en: In biology class, we learned the function of the penis in the male reproductive system.
examples.zh: 在生物課上，我們學到陰莖在男性生殖系統中的功能。

examples.en: The doctor explained that the penis is part of the male body.
examples.zh: 醫生說明陰莖是男性身體的一部分。

examples.en: A health textbook uses a simple diagram to show the penis.
examples.zh: 健康教育課本用簡單的圖來標示陰莖。

examples.en: Pensioners can ride the bus at half price.
examples.zh: 領退休金的人搭公車可以半價。

examples.en: The retired teacher is now a pensioner living by the sea.
examples.zh: 那位退休老師現在是領退休金的人，住在海邊。

examples.en: The city offers free health checks for pensioners.
examples.zh: 市政府為領退休金的人提供免費健康檢查。

senses.zh: 多年生的；長久的；一再出現的

examples.en: Roses are perennial plants that bloom year after year.
examples.zh: 玫瑰是多年生植物，年年開花。

examples.en: Traffic jams are a perennial problem in this city.
examples.zh: 塞車是這座城市長久以來的問題。

examples.en: The perennial question at every meeting is how to save money.
examples.zh: 每次開會一再出現的問題就是如何省錢。

examples.en: These perennials come back every spring without replanting.
examples.zh: 這些多年生植物每年春天都會長回來，不必重新種植。

examples.en: My mother planted several perennials along the garden wall.
examples.zh: 我媽媽沿著花園圍牆種了幾株多年生植物。

examples.en: Perennials usually cost more than annual flowers.
examples.zh: 多年生植物通常比一年生花卉貴。

examples.en: The doctor asked me to come for periodic checkups.
examples.zh: 醫生要我定期回診檢查。

examples.en: The machine needs periodic cleaning to work well.
examples.zh: 這台機器需要定期清潔才能運作良好。

examples.en: There are periodic changes in the weather on this island.
examples.zh: 這座島上的天氣會週期性地變化。

examples.en: The library has a large collection of science periodicals.
examples.zh: 圖書館有大量的科學期刊。

examples.en: She reads a travel periodical every month.
examples.zh: 她每個月都會讀一本旅遊期刊。

examples.en: This periodical publishes articles written by students.
examples.zh: 這份期刊刊登學生寫的文章。

examples.en: The school publishes a periodical newsletter for parents.
examples.zh: 學校為家長定期出版一份通訊。

examples.en: He sent periodical reports to the head office.
examples.zh: 他定期向總公司寄送報告。

examples.en: Periodical floods have affected the village for years.
examples.zh: 週期性的洪水多年來一直影響著這座村莊。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread permeated the whole house.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味瀰漫了整間屋子。

examples.en: Rainwater slowly permeated the soil and reached the roots below.
examples.zh: 雨水慢慢滲入土壤，抵達下方的根部。

examples.en: Social media has permeated every part of student life.
examples.zh: 社群媒體已經遍及學生生活的每個層面。

examples.en: The mountain top is covered in perpetual snow.
examples.zh: 山頂終年覆蓋著積雪。

examples.en: The baby's perpetual crying kept us awake all night.
examples.zh: 嬰兒不停地哭，讓我們整晚沒睡。

examples.en: He lives in perpetual fear of making mistakes.
examples.zh: 他總是活在害怕犯錯的恐懼中。

examples.en: The last question on the test perplexed most of the students.
examples.zh: 考卷上的最後一題難住了大部分學生。

examples.en: His strange reply perplexed everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 他奇怪的回答讓房間裡的每個人都很困惑。

examples.en: It perplexes me why the store closes so early.
examples.zh: 我實在不懂這家店為什麼這麼早打烊。

examples.en: With perseverance, she finally passed the driving test.
examples.zh: 憑著毅力，她終於通過了駕照考試。

examples.en: Learning a new language requires patience and perseverance.
examples.zh: 學習一種新語言需要耐心和毅力。

examples.en: The coach praised the team for its perseverance.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚球隊的堅持不懈。

examples.en: These rules pertain to all students in the school.
examples.zh: 這些規定適用於學校裡的所有學生。

examples.en: Please read the notes that pertain to your department.
examples.zh: 請閱讀與你們部門有關的註記。

examples.en: Questions pertaining to payment should be sent to the office.
examples.zh: 與付款有關的問題請寄給辦公室。

examples.en: Please include only pertinent information in your report.
examples.zh: 請在報告中只放入相關資訊。

examples.en: She asked several pertinent questions during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在會議中提出了幾個中肯的問題。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a pertinent example from real life.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一個貼切的真實生活例子。

senses.zh: 農藥（包括殺蟲劑、除草劑等）

examples.en: Farmers spray pesticide on the crops to protect them from insects.
examples.zh: 農夫在作物上噴灑農藥，保護它們不受蟲害。

examples.en: Wash the vegetables well to remove any pesticide.
examples.zh: 蔬菜要洗乾淨，去除殘留的農藥。

examples.en: This farm grows rice without using any pesticide.
examples.zh: 這座農場種稻米時完全不使用農藥。

examples.en: She works for a large pharmaceutical company.
examples.zh: 她在一家大型製藥公司工作。

examples.en: The pharmaceutical industry spends a lot on research.
examples.zh: 製藥業在研究上花費很多。

examples.en: Pharmaceutical products must pass strict safety tests.
examples.zh: 藥品必須通過嚴格的安全測試。

examples.en: The store sells pharmaceuticals and other health products.
examples.zh: 這家店販售藥品和其他保健產品。

examples.en: Many pharmaceuticals are cheaper in generic form.
examples.zh: 許多藥品的學名藥版本比較便宜。

examples.en: The country imports most of its pharmaceuticals.
examples.zh: 這個國家的藥品大多仰賴進口。

examples.en: She is studying pharmacology at the university.
examples.zh: 她在大學學習藥理學。

examples.en: Pharmacology explains how medicine affects the body.
examples.zh: 藥理學說明藥物如何影響身體。

examples.en: The pharmacology class includes lab work every week.
examples.zh: 藥理學課程每週都有實驗課。

examples.en: Sleep is a basic physiological need for everyone.
examples.zh: 睡眠是每個人的基本生理需求。

examples.en: The study looked at physiological changes during exercise.
examples.zh: 這項研究探討運動時的生理變化。

examples.en: Hunger and thirst are physiological signals from the body.
examples.zh: 飢餓和口渴是身體發出的生理訊號。

examples.en: Our biology teacher is an expert in human physiology.
examples.zh: 我們的生物老師是人體生理學的專家。

examples.en: He took a course in physiology before entering medical school.
examples.zh: 他在進醫學院之前修了一門生理學課程。

examples.en: The physiology of a bird is very different from that of a fish.
examples.zh: 鳥類的生理機能和魚類很不一樣。

examples.en: We stayed in a picturesque village near the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們住在山邊一座風景如畫的村莊。

examples.en: The picturesque old street attracts many tourists.
examples.zh: 這條別緻的老街吸引了許多遊客。

examples.en: They took photos of the picturesque harbor at sunset.
examples.zh: 他們在日落時拍下風景如畫的港口。

examples.en: Use a fork to pierce the potatoes before baking them.
examples.zh: 烘烤前先用叉子在馬鈴薯上戳洞。

examples.en: The sharp needle pierced the thick cloth easily.
examples.zh: 尖銳的針輕易穿透了厚布。

examples.en: She had her ears pierced when she was twelve.
examples.zh: 她十二歲時穿了耳洞。

examples.en: A piercing whistle told the players to stop.
examples.zh: 一聲刺耳的哨音要球員們停下來。

examples.en: The piercing wind made us hurry indoors.
examples.zh: 刺骨的寒風讓我們趕緊進屋。

examples.en: The teacher gave him a piercing look.
examples.zh: 老師給了他一個銳利的眼神。

examples.en: Ear piercing is popular among teenagers.
examples.zh: 穿耳洞在青少年之間很流行。

examples.en: She was careful to clean her new piercing every day.
examples.zh: 她很小心地每天清潔新穿的耳洞。

examples.en: The school does not allow facial piercings.
examples.zh: 學校不允許臉部穿環。

examples.en: The old woman was known for her piety and kindness.
examples.zh: 那位老婦人以虔誠與善良聞名。

examples.en: Many people visit the temple to show their piety.
examples.zh: 許多人到廟裡參拜以表達虔誠。

examples.en: His piety grew stronger as he got older.
examples.zh: 隨著年紀增長，他的虔誠之心也更深。

senses.zh: 虔誠的；道貌岸然的（貶義）

examples.en: My grandmother is a pious woman who prays every morning.
examples.zh: 我奶奶是個虔誠的人，每天早上都會祈禱。

examples.en: The pious villagers gathered at the temple for the festival.
examples.zh: 虔誠的村民們在節日當天聚集在廟裡。

examples.en: The manager made pious promises of fairness but ignored the workers' complaints.
examples.zh: 經理空口承諾公平，卻無視員工的抱怨。

examples.en: It really pissed me off when the bus was late again.
examples.zh: 公車又誤點，真的讓我很火大。

examples.en: Don't piss off your boss by missing the deadline.
examples.zh: 別因為錯過期限而惹老闆生氣。

examples.en: The unfair rule pissed the students off.
examples.zh: 這項不公平的規定讓學生們很火大。

examples.en: The museum displays an antique pistol from the 1800s.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一把十九世紀的古董手槍。

examples.en: The referee fired the starting pistol to begin the race.
examples.zh: 裁判鳴發令槍，比賽開始。

examples.en: The child was playing with a toy pistol at the party.
examples.zh: 那個孩子在派對上玩玩具手槍。

senses.zh: 灰泥；石膏；傷口貼布（英式）

examples.en: The workers covered the wall with a layer of plaster.
examples.zh: 工人用一層灰泥把牆壁覆蓋起來。

examples.en: He wore a plaster cast on his arm for six weeks.
examples.zh: 他的手臂打了六週石膏。

examples.en: Put a plaster on the cut to keep it clean.
examples.zh: 在割傷處貼上傷口貼布，保持清潔。

senses.zh: 塗灰泥；覆滿（海報、乳霜等）

examples.en: They plastered the ceiling before painting it.
examples.zh: 他們先在天花板上抹灰泥才上漆。

examples.en: Fans plastered the walls of the room with posters.
examples.zh: 粉絲在房間牆上貼滿了海報。

examples.en: The kids plastered their faces with sunscreen.
examples.zh: 孩子們把防曬乳塗得滿臉都是。

examples.en: The village sits on a high plateau in the north.
examples.zh: 這座村莊坐落在北部的一片高原上。

examples.en: Sales have reached a plateau after months of growth.
examples.zh: 銷售額在連續成長數月後進入停滯期。

examples.en: Many tourists visit the plateau to see the sunrise.
examples.zh: 許多遊客到高原上看日出。

examples.en: Prices plateaued after the holiday season.
examples.zh: 物價在假期過後趨於平穩。

examples.en: Her test scores plateaued even though she studied harder.
examples.zh: 雖然她更用功讀書，成績卻不再進步。

examples.en: The number of new users has started to plateau.
examples.zh: 新用戶的人數開始停滯不前。

examples.en: His excuse for being late sounded plausible.
examples.zh: 他遲到的藉口聽起來很合理。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a plausible explanation for the result.
examples.zh: 老師為這個結果提供了一個合理的解釋。

examples.en: It is plausible that prices will rise next year.
examples.zh: 明年物價可能上漲，這是說得通的。

examples.en: The report describes the plight of homeless families in winter.
examples.zh: 這份報告描述了無家可歸的家庭在冬天的困境。

examples.en: Volunteers came to ease the plight of the flood victims.
examples.zh: 志工前來緩解水災災民的困境。

examples.en: Nobody noticed the plight of the stray dogs in the park.
examples.zh: 沒有人注意到公園裡流浪狗的困境。

examples.en: She plucked a ripe orange from the tree.
examples.zh: 她從樹上摘了一顆熟橘子。

examples.en: He plucked the guitar strings softly.
examples.zh: 他輕輕撥動吉他琴弦。

examples.en: The chef plucked the feathers from the chicken.
examples.zh: 廚師拔掉雞身上的羽毛。

examples.en: It took a lot of pluck to speak in front of the whole school.
examples.zh: 在全校面前演講需要很大的勇氣。

examples.en: The young player showed great pluck in the final game.
examples.zh: 這位年輕球員在決賽中展現了十足的膽識。

examples.en: Her pluck helped her start a business at age twenty.
examples.zh: 她的勇氣讓她二十歲就創了業。

senses.zh: 以未沸騰的液體烹煮；偷獵

examples.en: I like to poach eggs for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我喜歡做水波蛋當早餐。

examples.en: The cook poached the fish in a light broth.
examples.zh: 廚師用未沸騰的清湯煮魚。

examples.en: Rangers work hard to stop people from poaching elephants.
examples.zh: 護管員努力阻止人們非法獵捕大象。

examples.en: She took some money out of her pocketbook.
examples.zh: 她從皮夾裡拿出一些錢。

examples.en: I left my pocketbook on the bus this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上把皮夾忘在公車上了。

examples.en: The sales clerk handed her the pocketbook with a smile.
examples.zh: 店員微笑著把手提包遞給她。

examples.en: The witch's hat in the play had a pointed top.
examples.zh: 戲劇裡女巫的帽子有尖尖的帽頂。

examples.en: She made a pointed remark about his late arrival.
examples.zh: 她對他的遲到說了一句尖銳的話。

examples.en: The cat has pointed ears and bright green eyes.
examples.zh: 那隻貓有尖尖的耳朵和明亮的綠眼睛。

senses.zh: 準備就緒的；沉著從容的

examples.en: The runners were poised at the starting line.
examples.zh: 跑者們在起跑線上蓄勢待發。

examples.en: She gave a poised speech in front of the class.
examples.zh: 她在全班面前發表了從容的演說。

examples.en: The company is poised to open three new stores next year.
examples.zh: 公司準備明年開設三家新店。

examples.en: Cars release harmful pollutants into the air.
examples.zh: 汽車會向空氣中排放有害的汙染物。

examples.en: The factory must reduce the pollutants it sends into the river.
examples.zh: 工廠必須減少排入河川的汙染物。

examples.en: Scientists tested the water for common pollutants.
examples.zh: 科學家檢驗水中是否含有常見的汙染物。

examples.en: Thousands of people gathered to see the pope.
examples.zh: 數千人聚集起來要看教宗。

examples.en: The pope will visit several Asian countries this year.
examples.zh: 教宗今年將訪問幾個亞洲國家。

examples.en: Our history teacher talked about a famous pope in the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師談到中世紀一位著名的教宗。

examples.en: Oil and dead skin cells can clog the pores on your face.
examples.zh: 油脂和老廢角質可能堵塞臉上的毛孔。

examples.en: Wash your face gently to keep your pores clean.
examples.zh: 輕輕洗臉，讓毛孔保持乾淨。

examples.en: Water passes through tiny pores in the rock and collects below.
examples.zh: 水穿過岩石中的細孔，在下方聚集。

examples.en: She pored over her notes the night before the exam.
examples.zh: 她在考試前一晚埋頭苦讀筆記。

examples.en: He pored over the map to find the shortest route.
examples.zh: 他仔細研究地圖，想找出最短的路線。

examples.en: The students pored over old photos in the library.
examples.zh: 學生們在圖書館裡仔細端詳老照片。

examples.en: Scientists postulate that life began in the sea.
examples.zh: 科學家假定生命起源於海洋。

examples.en: The teacher postulated a simple rule to explain the pattern.
examples.zh: 老師提出一個簡單的規則來解釋這個規律。

examples.en: Some experts postulate that prices will keep rising.
examples.zh: 有些專家假設物價會持續上漲。

examples.en: This postulate is the starting point of the whole theory.
examples.zh: 這個假設是整個理論的起點。

examples.en: Students must learn the basic postulates of geometry.
examples.zh: 學生必須學會幾何學的基本公設。

examples.en: The postulate was later proved to be correct.
examples.zh: 這個假說後來被證明是正確的。

examples.en: My grandfather grew up in the postwar years.
examples.zh: 我爺爺是在戰後那幾年長大的。

examples.en: The postwar economy of the country grew very quickly.
examples.zh: 這個國家戰後的經濟成長得非常快。

examples.en: We visited a museum about postwar life in the city.
examples.zh: 我們參觀了一座介紹這座城市戰後生活的博物館。

examples.en: The potter shaped the wet clay into a bowl.
examples.zh: 陶工把濕黏土捏成一個碗。

examples.en: We watched a potter at work in the old village.
examples.zh: 我們在老村莊裡看陶工做陶。

examples.en: My aunt became a potter after she retired.
examples.zh: 我阿姨退休後成了一名陶藝家。

examples.en: He likes to potter around the garden on Sundays.
examples.zh: 他週日喜歡在花園裡悠閒地忙這忙那。

examples.en: Grandma pottered about the kitchen making tea.
examples.zh: 奶奶在廚房裡慢悠悠地忙著泡茶。

examples.en: We pottered along the beach and picked up shells.
examples.zh: 我們沿著海灘閒逛，撿貝殼。

examples.en: It is not practicable to finish the project in two days.
examples.zh: 要在兩天內完成這個專案是不可行的。

examples.en: The committee chose the most practicable plan.
examples.zh: 委員會選擇了最可行的方案。

examples.en: Walking to school is practicable only when the weather is good.
examples.zh: 只有天氣好的時候，走路上學才行得通。

senses.zh: 大草原（尤指北美溫帶草原）

examples.en: The family drove across the wide prairie for hours.
examples.zh: 這家人開車穿越遼闊的大草原好幾個小時。

examples.en: Wild flowers covered the prairie in spring.
examples.zh: 春天時，野花開滿了草原。

examples.en: Many farms in the American Midwest sit on former prairie.
examples.zh: 美國中西部有許多農場建在過去的草原上。

senses.zh: 突然引發；（使）形成沉澱（化學）

examples.en: The sudden news precipitated a change in our travel plans.
examples.zh: 突如其來的消息使我們的旅遊計畫有了變動。

examples.en: A white solid began to precipitate when the two solutions were mixed.
examples.zh: 兩種溶液混合後，開始析出白色固體。

examples.en: His angry words precipitated an argument with his brother.
examples.zh: 他生氣的話引發了他與哥哥的爭吵。

examples.en: She regretted her precipitate decision to quit the club.
examples.zh: 她後悔當初倉促決定退出社團。

examples.en: A precipitate reply can cause misunderstandings.
examples.zh: 草率的回覆可能造成誤會。

examples.en: The team's precipitate departure surprised the coach.
examples.zh: 球隊倉促離開讓教練很意外。

examples.en: The train arrived at precisely nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 火車在九點整到達。

examples.en: Can you explain precisely what went wrong?
examples.zh: 你能精確地說明哪裡出了問題嗎？

examples.en: That is precisely why I called you.
examples.zh: 這正是我打電話給你的原因。

examples.en: A knee injury precluded him from joining the race.
examples.zh: 膝蓋受傷使他無法參加比賽。

examples.en: The contract does not preclude us from working with other firms.
examples.zh: 這份合約並未禁止我們與其他公司合作。

examples.en: Bad weather may preclude an outdoor event.
examples.zh: 天氣不好可能使戶外活動無法舉行。

examples.en: The ending of the movie was too predictable.
examples.zh: 這部電影的結局太容易預料了。

examples.en: Her reaction to the news was completely predictable.
examples.zh: 她對這個消息的反應完全在意料之中。

examples.en: We prefer a predictable schedule for the school year.
examples.zh: 我們比較喜歡這個學年有可預期的時間表。

examples.en: Rice is the predominant crop in this region.
examples.zh: 稻米是這個地區主要的農作物。

examples.en: Blue is the predominant color in her room.
examples.zh: 藍色是她房間裡的主色。

examples.en: English is the predominant language used at the conference.
examples.zh: 英語是這場會議中最主要使用的語言。

examples.en: The audience was predominantly young people.
examples.zh: 觀眾大多是年輕人。

examples.en: The town is predominantly quiet at night.
examples.zh: 這座小鎮夜晚大致上很安靜。

examples.en: Our class is predominantly made up of girls.
examples.zh: 我們班主要是由女生組成。
